chapters.title: ReSkill as a solution to talent gap
BC community needs next generation talent
ReSkill strategy combining industry and technology training
Professional skills training addresses soft skills gap

features.name: ReSkill talent development program
features.description: A professional services training program developed to address the talent gap in Business Central consulting by identifying people with industry experience, teaching them BC technology knowledge, and developing their consultant skills.

features.name: Professional skills training for consultants
features.description: Training program addressing the mindset and behavioral side of consulting, focusing on soft skills required to serve clients beyond just technology skill sets.
caveats: focuses on soft skills beyond technology
